The published row equals its printed line (par 35,714, cost 35,709, fv 35,134, Second Lien). The fund-quarter key covers the whole flagged population. as_filed matches the owner-accepted reason for this fund (DS-A01-1849894-5: the member the filer chose cannot be changed). Caveats: the carried_from source is the investigator's own reading, not an earlier independent review; this review is the independent one. The Metropolis preferred-equity part of the proposal statement no longer produces a failure in mszf. The proposal carries no rows, no per-member quarter on its evidence and rerun 'see report'; it needs those before the owner can accept it (D-253 bar).

Coverage and the data reading are right: the context C_1b43d218-f4f9-44fd-a7b6-855fa3faa1ac tags InvestmentBasisSpreadVariableRate 5.50, InvestmentInterestRate 9.99 and InvestmentInterestRatePaidInKind 3.00, the printed line shows B + 5.50 % ... 9.99 % (Incl 3.00 % PIK), and mszf publishes spread 5.50, rate 9.99, PIK 3.00, AUD par 77,196. The member label (B + 5.00%, 9.83%, Incl 2.75% PIK) is stale. Rejected on the next action: proposing as_filed. The owner-approved agentA repair REQ-APZ-1 (merged 1dcab241, before the mszf build) exists to drop exactly this label-only difference once the published field equals the printed line. mszf's shadow/agent_a_flags.csv shows why it still fires: printed_check = field_not_printed. The engine's printed-margin reader does not read the 'B +' (BBSY) benchmark code. So this is a check misfire, a false_alarm caused by the check. Under the 2026-11-04 owner ruling that is not a disposition; it clears when the check is repaired. Required next action: a check-repair request to read the 'B' / BBSY code in pipeline/printed_margin.py, with a test that a real spread error on a BBSY line still fails. Withdraw PD-agentA_spread_vs_xbrl-1849894-13.
